independent_retained_byte_audit.scope: Retained bytes, receipts, independently reconstructed structure and recorded outcomes only; no replay, live authority, signal/cancellation or universal machine-code proof.

limits: No actual community.c ingress, caller-RA authority, loader/init or arbitrary module admission.
Community identity/envelope and capability assumptions remain authored fixture inputs.
Generated-only lookup is not integrated module-first blame attribution.
The transformed orchestration is not byte-identical execution of the whole pinned installer or protection helper.
Maps query journal cap applies only to receipt-bearing queries; diagnostic queries are unjournaled.
No discarded-candidate cleanup selector, ADRP re-encode execution or constructor fallback execution.
No concurrent native invocation/publication, signal/nonlocal-exit, anonymous-PC unwind, general lifetime/race or hardware timing proof.
Assembly/generated code is not sanitizer instrumented; no TSan.
No emulator/deck action, production registry integration, live observer composition, package/catalog release or recovery permission.
Ownership is not fault causation; quarantine and all unresolved runtime gates are preserved.
Retained-byte audit rederives captured raw facts and binds named outcomes; scalar return values are not separately serialized, so it does not independently reconstruct every runtime predicate.
